resources.string: ✓ Blend is enabled. Tap “Switch keyboard” to use it.
Step 1: enable Blend in your keyboard settings.

• Space bar: slide left or right, or long-press it, to move the cursor like arrow keys. Drag up and down for lines. While moving, tap with a second finger to start or stop selecting text.
• Delete: tap to delete a letter. Hold to repeat (switches to whole words after a moment).
• Delete, swipe left: delete words backwards (keep dragging for more).
• Delete, swipe right: delete words forwards.
• Delete, swipe up: delete letters forwards (keep dragging for more).
• Delete, swipe down: delete back to the start of the line.
• Shift: tap for one capital, double-tap for caps lock. Hold shift while typing for capitals.
• Double-tap space to type a period.
• Globe: tap to switch keyboard, hold to pick one.
